searchText: If I understand this right, it means that if we in the future want to introduce a "real" v2 for an individually versioned endpoint, prysm will not be able to comply? I think Raul's comment was regarding their own API, not the standard API yep, for legacy reasons Prysm still uses its own internal API for critical functionality in prod. We have recently added support in beacon nodes for the standard beacon-apis, but it will take us some time to fully use them perfect, thanks! I wasn't sure which api was being referred to - just wanted to make sure we're on the same page with regards to v2 in the standard rest API 😉
